avelino-valencia.text: Campaign platform: "FULLY FUND SCHOOLS and improve teacher recruitment"; expand home construction and first-time buyer assistance; ensure universal California healthcare coverage.
Campaign platform lists housing: expand home construction and first-time buyer assistance programs.
Campaign platform lists healthcare: ensure universal California coverage.

rhonda-shader.text: Supports a simplified tax system with a competitive 25% rate, opposes the gas tax, and defends Prop 13 taxpayer protections.
"Rhonda will fight to keep violent criminals out of our communities and support our law enforcement officers."
Supports "education funding follow the student, giving parents more options, including charter schools."
Supports empowering local governments and faith-based organizations to increase shelter capacity, with more accountability for state homelessness programs.
Proposes letting small businesses and individuals pool insurance across state lines and reducing frivolous lawsuits to lower health costs.
Backs reduced regulatory burden for small businesses, including benefit-requirement exceptions for firms under 50 employees, and PAGA reform.
Advocates public-private partnerships for roads, utilities and broadband.

notes: Valencia votes are Assembly floor votes; Assembly vote on AB 1127 was NVR and SB 79/SB 627 are Senate-only, so not scored. Shader: BallotReady profile only; her own site was not located.
